name: Karan Ahuja
title: Lisa Wissner-Slivka and Benjamin Slivka Assistant Professor of Computer Science; Assistant Professor of Electrical and Computer Engineering by courtesy
department: Computer Science; Sensing, Perception, Interactive Computing and Experiences (SPICE) Lab
fitReason: Spatial-AI and embodied-perception backup with a live all-level visitor inquiry. Recent work combines neural motion priors, multimodal sensing and real-time XR interfaces. It suits perception/modeling interests; a robot-control project or access to an actuated robot has not been established.

physicalEvidence.summary: Full June 2026 MARIO methods inject an IMU-inferred human-pose prior into learned inertial odometry and fuse barometer, magnetometer and secondary-IMU cues. Experiments use Nymeria, Aria Everyday Activities and TLIO datasets; wearable deployment optimization remains future work. Full March 2026 SurfaceXR uses a temporal convolutional hand encoder, an IMU CNN and gated fusion for contact/gesture prediction. Actual Quest 3 and Pixel Watch 3 streams support laptop inference and XR surface interactions; 15 training-study participants and six independent test participants are distinct. Neither study executes robot actions. The live XR sensing apparatus is not credited as robot hardware, and the startup’s claimed robotics applications are not deployment evidence.

shortVisit.summary: The live personal homepage explicitly invites postdoctoral researchers, PhD students, master’s students, undergraduates and visitors through a linked interest form. The current SPICE homepage also links the research-interest form. This is a general visitor inquiry, not a confirmed outside-master summer placement. The form itself returned an authorization error during read-only retrieval, so its fields, duration requirements and current submission eligibility were not verified.

unknowns: No application, contact or form submission was made. Summer 2027 dates, eight-week duration, funding, remote work and supervision capacity are unknown. Current and prior graduate researchers establish advising activity, not automatic external-master access.

Reuse Northwestern institutional review from 2026-09-30T23:20:58Z. Visiting Predoctoral Fellow is doctoral-only. The separate Student Intern student supplement includes MA/PhD, but the currently linked November 2025 departmental checklist says current undergraduate. OISS and McCormick must resolve this conflict before treating an external master’s student as eligible.

The prior central Student Intern rules permit personal funding and one day to twelve months, require outside-US enrollment and return to complete the home degree, and at least 32 hours weekly. Published duration alone does not authorize the appointment. A scholar visa label is not a workaround for university visitor criteria.

The prior published support benchmark is $2,470 monthly excluding health insurance; the current central processing table lists $360 while older linked forms differ. These are not a complete budget or confirmed 2027 charges. Local host-paid fee rules, insurance, lead time, screening and project approval remain necessary.

SurfaceXR runs neural inference on an RTX 4090 laptop, not autonomously on the watch/headset. Its roughly 13.6 ms processing pipeline is not end-to-end gesture latency, which varies by gesture. No clinical efficacy, robot policy or on-device odometry deployment is inferred.
Public robot research does not confirm current equipment access, a summer 2027 offer or host availability.
